traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4 (1960), as Cirsium vulgare: stems 30 cm to 2 m tall. The typical value is the one the plant was drawn at before, inside the source's range.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: an introduced biennial thistle: a tall, branched, spiny stem with deeply lobed, spine-tipped leaves and large magenta flower heads on spiny green balls. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 1.2 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: dark grey-green leaves; magenta heads.

appearance.organs.flower.note: The head's look, the model's choice where the flora gives no number: about 130 phyllaries in its 10 to 12 rows; the florets standing 0.6 of the disc's radius out of the involucre, as the purple brush does in photographs; the head's colour the green of its involucre, its accent the florets' purple.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.note: FNA's account of the species (Keil, volume 19), as search results quote copies of its text (the pages themselves were not read): involucres hemispheric to bell-shaped, 3 to 4 cm tall and 2 to 4 cm across; phyllaries in 10 to 12 rows, overlapping, the outer and middle ones tipped with spines 2 to 5 mm long.

traits.pappus_length_m.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, C. vulgare (p. 517): pappus 2-3 cm long. Replaces the spec's 2-2.5 cm (VicFlora); see disagreements.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, Cirsium vulgare (p. 517): a biennial herb.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, C. vulgare (p. 517): cauline leaves oblong-lanceolate or oblong-oblanceolate or nearly ovate.

traits.leaf_division.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, C. vulgare (p. 517): one blade, pinnately lobed.

traits.leaf_incision.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, C. vulgare (p. 517): shallowly to deeply pinnately lobed.

traits.division_pattern.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, C. vulgare (p. 517): pinnately lobed.

traits.division_order.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, C. vulgare (p. 517): the ovate-deltoid lobes themselves shallowly parted or deeply cut into long lanceolate divisions.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, C. vulgare (p. 517): lobes and divisions end in stiff yellowish spines; stems spiny-winged by decurrent leaf bases.

traits.spines.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, C. vulgare (p. 517): the spines are the leaf lobes' tips and the decurrent leaf wings along the stem.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, C. vulgare (p. 517): heads borne singly at the ends of short branches, closely subtended by reduced upper leaves; a plant has few to many.

traits.disc_colour.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, C. vulgare (p. 517): corollas rose-purple, rarely white, 2.5-3.5 cm long. Word: rose-purple.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, C. vulgare (p. 517): achenes 3-3.5 mm long, light brown with dark lines.

traits.flowering_months.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, C. vulgare (p. 517): June to October.

traits.fruiting_months.note: FEIS's bull thistle review (Zouhar 2002, read 2026-10-16): plants "usually release seed in late summer and early autumn" and "seed dispersal immediately follows maturation"; read as August to October.

traits.capitulum_kind.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 443, Cirsium vulgare: capitulum kind discoid.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
